decisions.reason: The glass flake system extends the firm's core spraying expertise into heavy-duty corrosion protection, so the invested engineering and the visible commitment favour persisting, with modest web presence attributed to a slow market ramp-up.
The injection pump sits close to the established construction repair offer and has its own web page, a public commitment management will keep defending.
A multi-model transfer pump line carries substantial sunk development and tooling costs and is central to material conveying, so management will persist with it.

Fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the announced digitalized, monitored production direction, so management will attribute slow uptake to temporary causes despite its distance from core equipment.
The hydraulic two-component sprayer was launched only in 2024 and is close to the core offer, so it is too early for management to abandon its fresh investment.
